st: The Laci Peterson Story: A Dateline Investigation
d: After following the case for more than fifteen years, Dateline delivers a comprehensive report with rarely-seen interrogation video, new insight from prosecutors, and surprising details from the other woman, Amber Frey, who helped uncover the truth.
A man convicted of murdering a woman in her upscale Austin, Texas, home tells his story for the first time.
The sister of a man who died after robbing a bank when a bomb that was placed around his neck detonated talks about the case.
A woman's death is initially ruled a suicide, but when a new investigation begins, police begin to suspect murder.
